a.text: Thank you for your bulk purchase of our 'Bright Future' silky smooth shampoo products.

We are excited to announce our new promotional campaign, featuring a grand prize of two thousand Victorian pounds. Your recent purchase qualifies you for entry, and we have included a ticket for our prize lottery. We encourage you to try your luck!
Should you be one of our fortunate winners, please visit our factory headquarters in Caladon to claim your prize.
Thank you for your continued support.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Hmm~hmmhmm♪

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Let's see... A ceiling star projector for Quercus, the wind chimes on the mailbox for Kazemaru...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I still need things for Grani, Haze, Skyfire... the Doctor, Amiya, and Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Better get moving if I want to squeeze in time to visit my mates. It's been a while since I've been back at Caladon, wonder how everyone's doing.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Then there's this ticket. Even the smallest prize is twenty pounds, and there's an 8% chance of getting that, apparently...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I can't believe you need to collect your prize in person! If I hadn't come back to visit, I would've missed the chance.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Oh, it looks like the fancy ice cream shop over there's having some kind of promotion!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (Gulps)

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: My luck can't be that bad, can it? Let's wait until I get that twenty quid, then I can have a scoop. Just a scoop. That's all I need...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Alright, let's give it a scratch.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Twenty... Well, there it is. Wait, is that another zero at the end?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Two hundred... No, thousand...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Twenty thousand?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Twenty thousand?! The first prize?!
Susie rubs her eyes, holding the ticket up to the light.
It says, plain as day: '20000 pounds: Congratulations on First Prize!'

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Oh... Oh lord, this...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (Lowers her voice) No way! (Flustered) Okay, calm down... This is a lot of money. I-I need to...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I need to get back to the office right away to find Bitter Root, then we'll head to the prize exchange straight after.
Though her mind urges her to return to the Rhodes Island office, her legs have a will of their own and lead her to the ice cream shop.

steps.name: Ice Cream Seller
steps.text: Welcome! We're having a big sale today! 20% off a scoop, 50% off two!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: If I get two scoops... can I get different flavors?

steps.name: Ice Cream Seller
steps.text: Of course! If you'd like to try even more, then I'd say our variety bucket's your best value for money.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Nope, I'm done. This bucket's too much for me, the brain freeze won't stop.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Heheh...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Look, we confirmed it's real, so you can stop checking it and giggling.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: The shampoo factory says their finance's on leave until next month, so you've got until then to put together a proper plan for how to spend that much money.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: First, I'll send half of it home. Ten thousand pounds should be enough to buy a much bigger and prettier house. Then, whatever's left can go towards business...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Hmm... Maybe I'll donate a bunch of hairdressing equipment to Rhodes Island? The kind that could give even Spot a haircut he likes in under ten minutes?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: (Burst out laughing)

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: How about putting yourself first? Ten thousand pounds is not that much for a company, but it's life-changing for a person.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Darn, the convoy's here...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Forgot to tell you Susie, but I've to go on a trip. I'll be back next month, then we can go claim the prize together, yeah?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Where're you headed to next? The convoy might be able to give you a ride.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I was going to look for James and the others, so... maybe I should check the pubs?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Sure, though ever since the accident with the Green Spark, the Infected community's workers haven't had a pub to go to.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I've heard some pubs outside let them in on the down-low for an extra fee. I figure they'll drag you there to celebrate your return.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Just take care not to get exposed. Last time someone got found out as Infected, those lousy drunkards beat him half to death.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I won't. I'll make sure everyone else is careful, too.

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: How much did you say that was again, Susie?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (Whispers) Twenty thousand pounds.

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: Twenty thousand pounds?!

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Shut up! Don't you think Sparky's got enough troubles without you opening your gob?!

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: (Whispers) Sorry 'bout that...

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: (Whispers) Let's not chat about this here. It's too risky.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Speaking of which, didn't they pass a bill for improved treatment of Infected workers before I left?

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: The bill's all well and good, but it'll take more than a piece of paper to change things.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: If it could, we wouldn't have to sneak around just for a drink now, would we?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I'm really sorry, mister, I didn't mean to—

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Hold on, Susie. Is that... a knife in his hand?

steps.name: Suspicious Man
steps.text: You bloody little... static freak!

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Terribly sorry about all that. We've sent someone to chase the pickpocket.

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Everyone gets a glass of our special, on the house. Please don't let his tomfoolery give you the wrong idea about our fine establishment.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Hold up a sec, I remember you. Ain't you the git who shakes down the Infected the hardest just for wantin' a pint? Didn't have enough on me last time, so you—

steps.name: Barkeep
steps.text: Perish the thought, sir! Please don't joke about such things! How could you possibly be an Infected?
No one listens to the barman, but no one is avoiding the Infected like they usually do either.

steps.name: Whispering Voice
steps.text: Twenty thousand? You serious?

steps.name: Whispering Voice
steps.text: Hey, isn't that the girl who exposed Councilor Bishmer's scheme? Susie Glitter?

steps.name: Whispering Voice
steps.text: I've got a relative who won two hundred grand buying a terminal the other day! I heard they quit their jobs the very next day, then went to Siesta for some R&R...

steps.name: Whispering Voice
steps.text: Why else would the girl install some electric gadget to protect her wallet?

steps.name: Whispering Voice
steps.text: Hmph. That much money is wasted on the Infected anyway. If I had that kind of money...

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: We better get out of here.

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Move!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: *yawn* Morning already... I sure had a lot of nightmares last night.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: The ticket... Still here.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: That slip of the tongue back in the pub... I'm sure nobody believed us.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I still have plenty of time to think over how I want to spend this money.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Miss Glitter? Rhodes Island's Miss Susie Glitter? I've put your mail in the letterbox, do make sure to check it!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Mail? For me?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Oh, the mailman's gone. Let me see...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Oh my goodness! Why're there so many letters in there?!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: And... they're all for me?!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: 'Got a windfall burning a hole in your pocket? Leave it to the investing guru certified by the Duke of Gododdin himself to double your wealth...'

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: 'Dear Susie, I hail from Boschendal, just like you. I even held you when you were just a baby. You might not remember me, but...'

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: 'Please help us, Miss Glitter. Our stores in the Boil have been running at a loss year after year, but with a single investment from you...'

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I didn't realize I was quite so famous.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: 'To the Hero of the City, Miss Susie Glitter. I am glad to hear of your return to the city, for I am a great admirer of your bravery in standing up in the name of justice for the common man, and would like to invite you to my humble abode...'

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: What is even happening...?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Well, as long as I don't fall for any of that, I should be fine.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I can't let this money ruin my plans! Cheer up, Susie, there's still plenty of friends to see and gifts to pick out!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Wait, I should find somewhere safer to keep this ticket first.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: *sigh* It's already noon... What should I get Grani? Weapon maintenance lubricant?

steps.name: Meticulous Man
steps.text: Excuse me, would you happen to be Miss Susie Glitter?

steps.name: Meticulous Man
steps.text: You needn't be so on guard, we met once at the Green Spark.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: That's a pub for the Infected. You sure you've been there before?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: This should do. Grani's sure to be happy with it.

steps.name: Overfamiliar Woman
steps.text: Is that really you, Susie?! It must be! C'mere already, am I glad to finally meet you in person.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Do I... know you?

steps.name: Overfamiliar Woman
steps.text: No, but does it matter? We just need some time before we're the best of friends. Want a drink? My treat.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: No thank you.

steps.name: Tear-Streaked Passerby
steps.text: Please, I've got four kids to feed, and the factory let me go just yesterday. I've got nothing...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Here, five pounds. Please, just take it...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I should really get back to the office now. I think there are even more people coming my way...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: D-Did someone try to mess with the lock?!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Oh no! Rhodes Island's medicines are in there too!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Phew... No one's come in, thank heavens.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I better keep the door shut tight!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Wh-Who's there?! D-Don't come in!

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Susie, it's me, Bean.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Mr. Bean? Are you here to... ask for money as well?

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: (Awkwardly clears throat) No, nothing of the sort.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Look, we're terribly sorry, Susie. I'm here to apologize on Stone's behalf too. We've caused nothing but trouble for you with our big mouths.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: No, it's okay, it wasn't on purpose.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Actually, I came here to...

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Discuss something with you.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Now that you're well-off, we were wondering if... we could rebuild the Green Spark, right where it used to be.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: I know we're asking too much and it's not our money to begin with. I... Just forget I said anything. Where's Bitter Root by the way?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: On a work trip.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Well, he better come back soon. I don't like how a young lady's alone with that much money on you.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Bah, what's the point of me going on about all this? Anyways, you get some rest now.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Mr. Bean, how much would it cost to rebuild the Green Spark?

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Huh? Uh...

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Let me see... The lot's still there, no extra cost for that. A hundred quid to the city council and we can start working.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Rebuilding the interior should be about... a thousand and five, maybe six hundred. Add in the council's cut and some odds and ends, and I reckon two thousand pounds should do. Shouldn't be any higher than that.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Look, Susie...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Well, go ahead and call the council, then.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Of course. I'm doing alright for myself at Rhodes Island, so I think it's better I put all this money to good use helping everyone out before it turns my entire life upside down.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: 'All this money'? No way, surely we couldn't possibly need that much?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: It's fine, really. See the mailbox outside? It'll be much better than dealing with all these people from heaven-knows-where sending me letters.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Then, I'll go tell the lads the good news?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Yes! On the double!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Bitter Root! You're back!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I heard all about what happened. Who knew things could have taken such a turn in the two short weeks I was gone?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Oh, no need to sound so negative. I think it's all rather wonderful, really.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: James has been dropping by every day to give an update. Sounds like it'll be fully rebuilt in a few days.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Two thousand pounds, was it? Bean's estimate was pretty accurate. Low-ball, even.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Not like there's any more to give. I haven't cashed in the ticket yet, so all I had was that two thousand quid. It really did all go towards rebuilding the Green Spark. Not a single penny's gone towards wages.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Wages, huh... I don't think Bean ever brought the topic up with you. Is that really alright? You might have to take a big chunk out of the ten grand you left for yourself. Not sure how much'll be left after.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: It's fine. Everyone's been having a rough time, so it's the least I could do. If it wasn't rebuilding the pub, I'd still be helping them out some other way.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Paying them is the least I can do for their hard work, even if they're too embarrassed to bring it up.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Figuring that out yourself means you've got a good head on your shoulders.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Oh, right, the finance from that shampoo factory should be back from holiday, right? Can't take them longer than building a pub, can it?

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: May I help you, sir...?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: We're here to trade in this ticket.

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: Oh, a friend of Susie's, I see.

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: Judging by the grins on your faces, you must have won big! Congratulations, second prize and two thousand pounds should keep you comfortable for quite some time, even if you splurge a bit!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Two thousand pounds?

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: Right, two thousand Victorian pounds—

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Sorry, miss, but mind reading that ticket again? I think you forgot a zero.

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: Wait, what? What's it say?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Twenty thousand pounds. First prize.

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: First prize?!

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: That can't be right... Hold it up for me while I confirm it.

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: Well, there's certainly nothing wrong with it. How peculiar...

steps.name: Factory Director
steps.text: What's going on here? What's all the commotion?

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: Sir, this young lady's won our first prize, but as I recall, someone redeemed first prize before I went on leave, no?

steps.name: Factory Director
steps.text: Hmm? Mind if I see that ticket?

steps.name: Factory Director
steps.text: Th-This...

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: The other first prize ticket's over here... Why are there two tickets with identical numbers?

steps.name: Factory Director
steps.text: Well, this one's obviously a phony! Qu-Quick, call the police, and get these two scammers out of my sight at once!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: With all due respect, sir, but what the hell are you talking about?

steps.name: Finance
steps.text: He's right, sir. Miss Glitter here is an upstanding, honest soul. Why, she's even been named 'the City's Hero'! Why would she do such a thing?
The two sides stare daggers at one another, but before things can escalate any further, Susie begins to speak.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Why did it have to be like this... Why...?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I... I can't pay their wages...
She does not cry, but her helpless muttering is more heart-breaking than any sobbing or weeping.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Oh, hey! Bitter Root, Susie! Perfect timing—

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Bean, there's something I have to tell you and the others.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: What could be more important than this? There's just one last thing we have to do before the job's done: put the Green Spark's sign back up where it belongs!

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Would you like to do the honors, Susie?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Susie...?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: N-No... I can't...

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Why the sad look? Bad memories?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: No. I... I'm fine.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: I'll hang it up, then! Everyone's been fighting over who gets to do it.
Susie follows Bean to the Green Spark's front door.

The arboretum and lighting store has been restored to the way it was before the fire, with one new addition. Tucked away in a corner of the pub is a mirror, a barber's chair and all sorts of hairdressing equipment.
The gilded lettering across the storefront glints and glimmers, and the entire store is awash with the smell of a newly furnished building.
Bean climbs up a ladder, gingerly hanging up the Green Spark's sign as applause and cheering break out all around him.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Here's to a bar that won't give us the stink eye! Three cheers for the Green Spark!

steps.name: Infected District Workers
steps.text: Hip hip, hooray!
Susie looks around the rebuilt arboretum and lighting store-slash-pub-slash-barbershop.
It should have been the start of a new life for her.
At the very least, its reconstruction could have provided some income for those who contributed.
But why, why did it always come to this?
Upon hearing the cheering crowd, she feels a lump in her throat and her vision begins to blur.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Susie, we know the place holds some bad memories for you, but...

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: Oh, come on now, Sparky, you're breaking my heart with your crying. What's the matter?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: The ticket... The head of the factory said it was fake, but it's not... The twenty thousand pounds, my savings, everyone's lives... *sob*...

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: The ticket? A fake?

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: You were going to say something to Bean earlier, Bitter Root. What's going on here?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: The shampoo factory won't accept Susie's ticket. They say the first prize has already been claimed.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: What kind of game are they playing?!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: The lottery was obviously rigged, but the boss messed up and Susie ended up with the real first prize ticket. Now they're saying it was a printing error and won't give her a penny.

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: They got some bloody stones on them. The 'Bright Future' factory, yeah? That's just to the south of the Infected block. Susie's been buying their product from the start, all because they said they'd support our community, no?

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: Is this the kind of 'support' their chief meant?

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: Let's go, boys! We're gonna have ourselves a chat!

steps.name: Infected District Workers
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Hold it, most of you are Infected. If you all head to the factory, wouldn't you...?

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Not to worry. We'll be there with them.

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: We're not looking to start a riot. We're just going to tell that director that if he doesn't honor Susie's ticket, none of us will be buying his product, and we'll go on strike too!

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Caladon named her a Hero of the City, for crying out loud! How could they do this to someone like that?

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Cheer up, Susie. Let's go give them a piece of our mind together!

steps.name: City Council Administrator
steps.text: Allow me to once again apologize to you, Miss Susie Glitter, and your concerned friends.

steps.name: City Council Administrator
steps.text: While this incident is suspicious, I'm afraid there's no direct evidence that the factory director has been involved in lottery fraud.

steps.name: City Council Administrator
steps.text: He has agreed to compensate Miss Glitter two thousand Victorian pounds, alongside two shipments of 'Bright Future' shampoo. Consider the matter settled. I ask all present to refrain from causing any further complications.

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Hold on a sec, this isn't—

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: *sigh* Bollocks. Typical Infected discrimination. If it was one of those councilors bringing up the matter, he'd be going 'yes, milord' right away.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Stuff it. Talking about it won't change a thing.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: At least it's better than coming out empty-handed.

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Here, this should be enough to pay off our tab.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: Well... Now that that's all done and dusted, we should head back home now. Sorry, Susie, for making things harder on you.

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: If anything comes up in the future, remember to give us a shout! I'll be the first one over!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Huh...? Ah!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Wait! James, Stone, Mr. Bean, everyone, wait!

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Eh? What's the matter, something else on your mind?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Your wages...

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Wages? Bean says he talked everything over with you that day.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I was going to use a big chunk of that twenty grand to pay everyone for their time and effort. It was supposed to help improve your lives...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: The payout's only two thousand pounds now, and I don't have any more savings on me, so all I can do is divide this up between you all—

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Wait, Susie, darling, I think you've got this all wrong.

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Bean, what in the blazes did you tell her that day?

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Uh, well, Susie told me 'I think it's better I put all this money to good use helping everyone out before it turns my entire life upside down', then I said 'Surely we couldn't possibly need that much'...

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: That's all?

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: That's... pretty much it.

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Bean, you twat! Can't you understand the words coming out of your own damn mouth?! You made Susie think we were a charity case!

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Rebuilding the Green Spark might not be Susie's idea, but it's her money paying for it! Did you have the cheek to mention wages to her too?

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Lord no, I didn't mention any of the sort! What kind of shameless bastard d'you think I am?

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: Still not willing to admit it, are you? Look at how much of a frizzle she's in thanks to you!

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Alright, I'm sorry, I'm sorry. Apologies, Susie, and everyone else...

steps.name: Stone the Infected
steps.text: Apologies won't cut it! At least give the Green Spark some free work for a month!

steps.name: Infected District Workers
steps.text: Hear hear!
The Infected workers continue to make a fuss, though it's mostly in good-natured teasing.
Bitter Root glances at Susie. The infectious laughter transforms her sad and apologetic expression into one of joy and warmth.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Everyone, wait, I still think—

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: Consider our minds made up, Susie. If you're still insisting on giving us money, we'd have to consider you and Bean in cahoots!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: But... I can't just let everyone work for free—

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Susie. Just leave that all aside for the moment.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: If you say so...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Then, James, could you help move this chair, mirror, and all the hairdressing equipment out of the store?

steps.name: James the Worker
steps.text: I mean, sure, but why...?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I couldn't possibly take all this shampoo with me, so it's best I give everyone a haircut right now!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: No offense, but I've been meaning to do something about your scruffy hairdos! I won't make you work for free, Mr. Bean, if you sit down nice and quiet, alright?

steps.name: Bean the Infected
steps.text: Hahaha, sure, sure.

steps.name: Infected District Workers
steps.text: Aren't you letting him off too lightly?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Don't think you lot can get away either!

a.text: We're terribly sorry for all the trouble we caused you. The shampoo factory chief might be a right bastard, but we're hardly any better. We nearly let you spend all your savings on rebuilding the Green Spark.
As for the wages you wouldn't stop bringing up before you left Caladon, we settled on a Columbian approach to the matter:
Since we 'invested our labor' in building the place, we'll take half the pub's income and split it among ourselves. How does that sound?
